title: Polar H10 HRV Session RMSSD Leaderboard
dataSources: Apple Health metrics (`apple:health`), Oura Ring daily readiness/sleep (`oura:daily`), Whoop recovery/strain (`whoop:cycle`), Withings body/blood-pressure (`withings:measure`), Dexcom CGM glucose (`dexcom:egv`).
app: Apple Health / Apple Watch exports (Health Auto Export, Shortcuts) via HEC; Oura, Whoop, Withings, Dexcom APIs via scripted REST inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=polar:hrv rmssd_ms=*
| stats sum(rmssd_ms) as total_value, avg(rmssd_ms) as avg_value by measurement_type
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks measurement type values by total and average rmssd across Polar H10 HRV session events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `rmssd_ms` values for each Polar H10 HRV session event and review total and average rmssd by measurement type.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total rmssd.
grandmaExplanation: It charts which measurement type shows the biggest rmssd numbers in your Polar H10 HRV session data.
